key_insight: PANORAMA improves image captioning by grounding descriptions to the right image regions using selected mask proposals, aiming to produce captions that are both detailed and spatially accurate.
problem_solved: The paper addresses the challenge of panoptic grounded captioning: generating comprehensive image descriptions while reliably linking each described object or region to accurate pixel-level masks. Existing methods often trade off between caption completeness and grounding quality.
method: Formulate panoptic grounded captioning as a task that combines dense captioning with panoptic-level segmentation grounding.
Select high-quality mask proposals to better align textual descriptions with object regions and reduce inaccurate mask assignments.
Use a vision-language framework that produces fluent captions while maintaining pixel-level spatial grounding.
impact: This matters for AI practitioners because it moves VLMs closer to real-world visual understanding, where systems must not only describe scenes well but also know exactly what parts of an image those descriptions refer to. It is useful for robotics, assistive vision, and interactive perception systems.
